description:
Earthwool Wall and Ceiling Batts are high-performance glass
mineral wool insulation batts manufactured by Knauf Insulation using ECOSE
Technology. Engineered with a bio-based binder containing no added formaldehyde,
phenol, or acrylics, Earthwool batts are soft to handle, low-dust, and
non-combustible. Featuring TwinTech dual-forming manufacturing for a smooth
finish on both sides, they improve the thermal comfort and energy efficiency of
residential and commercial buildings while absorbing airborne acoustic sound.
features: ECOSE Technology bio-based binder with no added formaldehyde
TwinTech dual-forming technique ensures a smooth finish on both sides
Non-combustible when tested in accordance with AS 1530.1

Soft to handle,

Manufactured using up to 80% recycled glass

Compression packed into robust
poly packs for easier transport and handling

Low VOC emissions and Eurofins

Backed by a 50-year product warranty

install:
Isolate electrical power at the main switchboard before
entering ceiling spaces or touching wall cavities

Friction fit batts snugly
between timber or steel framing members without gaps or folds

In ceilings,
lay batts flat between ceiling joists ensuring complete, continuous coverage
over plasterboard

At roof eaves, maintain minimum 20mm clearance between
insulation and roof cladding/sarking

Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around
non-IC rated recessed downlights and heat flues as per AS 3999

In walls,
ensure batts butt tightly against top and bottom plates and fill the cavity
without bulging plasterboard

Cut neatly around electrical boxes, plumbing,
and wiring using a sharp utility knife
selection_checklist:
Determine
application (ceiling vs external walls vs internal acoustic walls)

Select
required R-value to achieve 7-star NatHERS energy compliance for climate zone
Measure framing centers (430mm for 450mm centers; 580mm for 600mm centers)
Check wall cavity depth (75mm for 70mm studs; 90mm for 90mm studs)

Verify
downlight ratings (IC/IC-4 rated allows continuous insulation coverage per
AS 3999)
limitations:
Do not compress batts into cavities
narrower than nominal thickness as this reduces thermal R-value

Must be
protected from continuous water exposure and outdoor weather

Not designed as
an exposed decorative lining; must be enclosed behind plasterboard or internal
linings

not_for: Exposed decorative wall lining without plasterboard

Underfloor crawl spaces

rag_summary:
Knauf Earthwool Batts (Knauf Batt) are
non-combustible glass mineral wool thermal and acoustic insulation batts
manufactured using bio-based ECOSE Technology with zero added formaldehyde.
Available in wall ratings from R1.5 to R4.0 and ceiling ratings from R2.5 up to
Australia's thickest R7.0, they fit standard 430mm and 580mm framing without
slumping. Tested non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and certified under BRANZ
Appraisal 873 and GreenTag Level A, they provide an itch-free, low-dust
installation backed by a 50-year warranty.

description:
Earthwool Roof Blanket (with reflective foil laminate / Space
Blanket) is a glass mineral wool roll insulation factory-bonded to a reflective
foil facing, designed for thermal performance, condensation control, and
acoustic absorption under metal roofs. Manufactured with ECOSE Technology using
bio-based binders and up to 80% recycled glass, it significantly reduces radiant
heat gain and exterior rain drumming noise. The reflective foil facing acts as a
vapor barrier and radiant barrier, protecting metal roof assemblies from
condensation damage while complying with NCC fire and bushfire standards up to
BAL-40.

Factory-laminated with reflective foil facing including
a 150mm overlap flap

Dual thermal and acoustic performance: slows heat flow

underside of metal roof sheeting

complying with AS 1530.1

ECOSE Technology bio-based binder with no added
formaldehyde or harsh chemicals

Tested to AS 1530.2 with a low Flammability
Index (≤ 5)

Suitable for sealing ember entry points in bushfire zones up to
BAL-40 under AS 3959
Made using up to 80% recycled glass

Soft to handle,
low dust, and odorless

Group 1 fire classification compliant with AS 5637.1 /
AS ISO 9705

rag_summary:
Knauf Blanket Roof
Lamin (Earthwool Roof Blanket / Space Blanket) is a glass mineral wool
insulation blanket factory-laminated to a reflective foil facing with a 150mm
overlap flap. Engineered for installation under residential and commercial metal
roofs, it prevents condensation, reflects radiant heat, and dampens rain impact
drumming noise. Manufactured with bio-based ECOSE Technology, non-combustible
core (AS 1530.1), and low-flammability foil (Index ≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant), it
delivers ratings from R1.3 to R3.6 backed by a 50-year warranty.

description:
Martini MAB
(Multi-Application Blanket & Batts) is a premium commercial and industrial
polyester acoustic and thermal insulation manufactured by CSR Martini. Produced
in densities from 11 kg/m³ to 60 kg/m³ and thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm, it is
engineered to reduce echo and absorb reverberant sound in sports halls, cinemas,
studios, industrial enclosures, HVAC ducts, silencers, and plant rooms. Formed
from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibers containing up to 80% recycled PET
without chemical binders, it is completely non-toxic, non-irritant, and
non-allergenic.

Available in standard white, with black or grey available upon request

100% recyclable with high reuse potential
Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) certified in accordance with ISO 14025

rag_summary:
CSR
Martini MAB (Commercial Polyester / Martini MAB) is a premium acoustic and
thermal insulation manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester with up
to 80% recycled PET. Available in densities from 11 kg/m³ to 60 kg/m³ and
thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm (in white, grey, or acoustic black), it achieves

performance.

rag_summary:
Metecno Ballistic Point Insulation
Fastener (manufactured by ICCONS under the GTIF series and distributed across
the Australian commercial construction market) is a pre-assembled ballistic

rag_summary:
Misc Polystrapping is high-tensile polypropylene strapping (commonly 15mm
to 19mm wide in 500m to 1000m rolls) widely utilized in the Australian building
industry to support underfloor and ceiling insulation batts. Stapled across
timber joists or steel purlins at 300mm to 450mm intervals, it cradles
glasswool, polyester, and rockwool batts permanently in position, preventing
gravity sag, wind dislodgement, and loss of thermal contact with the floor.

Misc Reflective
represents generic reflective foil laminates, bubble foil, and building sarking
membranes used across Australian residential and commercial construction.
Engineered with high-purity aluminum foil facings that reflect up to 97% of
radiant heat when installed facing an enclosed air cavity, these products reduce
solar heat gain and assist in condensation management when installed in roofs,
walls, and sheds.
